blurb: Civil Society Brewing Co. is a family-operated craft brewery with locations in Jupiter and West Palm Beach, Florida. Guests can enjoy hop-forward beers and a full kitchen onsite at the Jupiter location, or a large taproom with an outdoor beer garden and food trucks at the West Palm Beach location. The brewery emphasizes craft, heritage, and community.
